description: YHPUseal-2925 is a single-component, moisture-curing, high solid content, polyurethane elastic joint sealant.
whereToUse: YHPUseal-2925 is used for sealing and weatherproofing joints in the building envelope where reliability and durability is required
Typical applications include joints in concrete panel and wall systems, around window and door frame, flashing, common roofing detail applications
advantages: Good adhesion to many construction materials

consumption.quote: For movement joints, the width must be at least 8 mm and should not exceed 40 mm
In all cases joints must be at least 8 mm deep
